title: Income Annuities Product Specifications: Payout Basis and Guarantee Structure by Tier
content:
Each tier of Ashgrove Income Annuities is built on one payout basis — the guarantee structure that decides what, if anything, continues after an annuitant's death.

## Specification table

| Tier | Payout basis | Period-certain years | Survivor continuation percentage | Whose death reduces a joint payment | Cash refund lump sum at death | Measure of the cash refund |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Income Annuity Life Only | Life only | 0 (none) | 0% | Either death | Not available | None |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity Cash Refund | Life with cash refund | 0 (none) | 0% | Either death | Available | Purchase amount less gross income payments made, never below zero |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity 10-Year Certain | Life with period certain | 10 | 0% | Either death | Not available | None |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity 20-Year Certain | Life with period certain | 20 | 0% | Either death | Not available | None |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity Joint 50% Survivor | Joint and survivor | 0 (none) | 50% | Either death | Not available | None |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity Joint 100% Survivor | Joint and survivor | 0 (none) | 100% | Either death | Not available | None |

## Meaning of each figure

- **Payout basis** — the guarantee structure of the tier: life only, life with cash refund, life with period certain, or joint and survivor.
- **Period-certain years** — the certain period, counted from the first payment date, during which payments continue to the beneficiary if the annuitant dies; 0 where the tier has none.
- **Survivor continuation percentage** — the share of the payment continued to the survivor after the first death on a joint tier; 0% on the single-life tiers.
- **Whose death reduces a joint payment** — on every tier the setting is "either death": the death of either joint annuitant is the first death that reduces the payment to the survivor percentage.
- **Cash refund lump sum at death** — whether a cash refund lump sum is payable at death; only the Cash Refund tier has it.
- **Measure of the cash refund** — on the Cash Refund tier, the purchase amount less the gross income payments made, never below zero; "none" on the other tiers.

## Reading the table (hypothetical illustrations)

- A contract on the Ashgrove Income Annuity 20-Year Certain tier has a certain period of 20 years from its first payment date; a contract on the 10-Year Certain tier has 10.
- On the Joint 50% Survivor tier, a hypothetical joint installment of $2,000.00 continues to the survivor after the first death at 50% of the installment; on the Joint 100% Survivor tier the survivor percentage is 100%, so the survivor share of the same installment is the whole $2,000.00.
- Only the Cash Refund tier shows a refund measure; the Life Only, period-certain and joint tiers show "none" and carry no cash refund lump sum.
